fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Small classes, patient teachers, real conversations

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Casa Tilde teaches Spanish to adults in the rooms above the bookshop on Call Lane, four evenings a week.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Two weeks of mornings in July, for anyone with a trip coming up.

default.name: Six at a table
default.text: Classes never grow past six, so everybody has spoken within the first ten minutes.

default.name: Spanish from minute one
default.text: Your teacher speaks slowly, draws a lot and switches to English only when you are truly stuck.

default.name: Thursday conversation café
default.text: An hour of talk over coffee with no textbook in sight, free for every student.

default.name: A library to borrow from
default.text: Four hundred graded readers, films and comics to take home between lessons.

default.name: Catch-up lessons
default.text: Miss a class and you can sit in on the same lesson with another group that week.

default.name: No exams unless you ask
default.text: We prepare you for the DELE certificate if you want it, and only then.
